localPlan.dueSourceText: DGCA refund rule. The rule gives no start day; Refund Genie counts from your cancellation date (Refund Genie's reading). About 14 working days, Monday to Friday; holidays ignored.
localPlan.note: Who owes you: still IndiGo. The rule puts the refund on the airline.
localPlan.body:
Dear Customer care email,

I am the passenger requesting the refund for my IndiGo flight (PNR SAMPLE, booking ID QA-SAMPLE-5400), cancelled 1 Oct 2026, for Rs 5400.

Under DGCA refund rule, paragraph 3(c), this refund is due by 21 Oct 2026.

Please share the refund date and the payment reference (UTR or ARN).

Thank you.
localPlan.subject: Flight refund status
